subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should this PR preserve current no-override `bootstrap-extra-files` behavior and limit root-only filtering to explicit tier choices, or should OpenClaw intentionally make hook extras require `bootstrapTier: "full"` for subagent/cron contexts?
rationale: The code issue is clear, but the permanent default and upgrade behavior change the public agent bootstrap/context contract and should be owned by maintainers rather than inferred from this branch.

options.title: Preserve Defaults Before Merge
options.body: Keep existing no-override hook-extra behavior and make hook-source exclusion apply only to explicit `minimal` and `standard` tier choices before merge.

options.title: Accept Root-Only Legacy
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally require `bootstrapTier: "full"` for hook extras in subagent/cron contexts, but the PR should add explicit docs, migration guidance, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Fold Into Bootstrap Design
options.body: Pause this PR behind the broader deterministic bootstrap/context design if maintainers want one selector contract for tiering and related context controls.

recommendation.title: Preserve Defaults Before Merge
recommendation.body: Keep existing no-override hook-extra behavior and make hook-source exclusion apply only to explicit `minimal` and `standard` tier choices before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The subagent bootstrap filtering feature history and recent bootstrap helper review context make this the best available owner for the config/default decision.
